name: winnegans-fake
description: Crowdsourced scholarly annotation repository and viewer for James Joyce's Finnegans Wake

scripts.validate: uv run --with jsonschema python3 validate.py || python3 validate.py
scripts.validate:file: uv run --with jsonschema python3 validate.py --path || python3 validate.py --path
scripts.setup: pnpm install && make -C data && python3 build_page_index.py && python3 verify_data.py
scripts.check: pnpm validate && pnpm signatures:verify && pnpm test && pnpm build

author: WinnegansFake Contributors
